title: Studio Access: the permission matrix lists no objects while the package's objects are still drafts ("0 objects"), so a new package cannot be secured before its first publish
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Builders author objects and their access together; the matrix only shows published objects.

## Reproduction

1. New package with draft-only objects → Access › new set → "0 objects".
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/object?package=<pkg>` → `[]`; with `&preview=draft` → the objects are listed.

## Expected

The matrix lists draft objects (badged as drafts).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` ~846: `client.list` without `withPreviewDrafts`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Access QA card.
- Business reason: Forces a publish-without-permissions step for every new package.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:access`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `permission matrix lists no objects while package objects are drafts` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 21 hits, none about draft objects in the matrix (nearest closed #26349).
- QA id: A8
